name: BTCUSD_DQR_SWING_REVERSAL_V13
title: Daily Quality Reversal (DQR) for BTCUSD — D1 Swing-Level Sweep Reversal
spec_source: user discretionary brief STEP 1-3 verbatim; STEP 4+ agent-designed (owner spec was truncated after STEP 3)

timeframes.note: D1 execution is MANDATORY. The same logic on H1/H4 is deeply negative and NOT Monte-Carlo robust. Do not port to lower timeframes without re-validating from scratch.

step_1_levels.definition: confirmed D1 swing highs/lows, fractal left=2 right=2; the right-hand bars are required for confirmation, so a level is only usable after its defining bar closes
step_1_levels.level_strength: number of D1 closes within 0.30*ATR of the level, counted only over D1 bars already closed at signal time
step_1_levels.level_age_d1: days since the level became usable
step_1_levels.distance_from_price: measured in ATR, must be <= max_level_dist_atr

step_2_sweep.long: D1 low < level - tolerance AND close > level
step_2_sweep.short: D1 high > level + tolerance AND close < level
step_2_sweep.sweep_definition: deep_penetration — price must pierce the level by at least 0.25*ATR. A graze does not count as a liquidity sweep.

step_3_rejection.long: bullish body AND close_position >= 0.70 AND close back above the level
step_3_rejection.short: bearish body AND (1 - close_position) >= 0.70 AND close back below the level

step_4plus_agent_designed.momentum_confirmation: the bar immediately after the sweep bar is impulsive in the trade direction: |body| >= 0.80*ATR and close beyond the sweep bar's far side
step_4plus_agent_designed.decisive_break_rule: if any of the last 5 closed bars closed decisively beyond the level by 0.50*ATR, the level is BROKEN and the setup is skipped (spec item 6: reassess, not trade)
step_4plus_agent_designed.entry: open of the bar after the confirmation bar closes
step_4plus_agent_designed.exit: stop / target / 32-bar time exit, checked intrabar, closer level wins ties (pessimistic)
step_4plus_agent_designed.cooldown: no new entry within 4 bars of the previous entry

costs.spread: per-bar DB spread column (median 2250 pts = $22.50/side = 0.032% of price)
costs.note: BTC round-trip cost is ~4x gold's as a fraction of price. This materially changes which configs are viable and is why the fallback costs are symbol-specific.

contract_sizing.note: 1 lot = 1 BTC; USD P&L per lot equals the price move in USD
contract_sizing.account_constraint: On $1,000 a 1% risk cap ($10) buys 0.03 lots at a ~331-point stop. Wider stops floor the position to the 0.01 minimum or to zero. A $1,000 account is marginal for BTC.

anti_lookahead: levels gated by known_from = defining D1 bar close
sweep + confirmation evaluated on closed execution bars only
entry at the open of the bar AFTER the confirmation bar
features built on the full series then sliced by TIME, never sliced before building
dynamic touch counts only ever see D1 bars already closed

m1_lower_tf_revalidation_2026_09_30.config: FROZEN V13 D1 config, no re-tuning on any lower TF
m1_lower_tf_revalidation_2026_09_30.account: $1,000, 1% risk/trade, min 0.01 lot, BTC $1/lot per $1 move
m1_lower_tf_revalidation_2026_09_30.data_note: M1 BTCUSD history is 97,618 bars = 68 days (2026-07-22..2026-09-28). That is the MT5 ~100k bar request cap, NOT broker retention. Two months is a DESCRIPTIVE REPLAY, not a validation.

M30.note: The ONLY lower TF that is MC-robust, and it still LOSES money on a real $1,000 account (-4.64%). PF 1.09 pips over 4 years does not clear the 230-pip round trip often enough. 210 of 345 signals were untradeable at the 0.01 lot floor. NOT a candidate.

H1_money.note: 333 of 372 signals untradeable at min lot; account would be wiped.

H4_money.note: 122 of 149 signals untradeable at min lot.

D1_money.note: CRITICAL: on a real $1,000 account the winning D1 config still only makes +1.70% over 13.7 years, because 28 of 36 signals cannot be sized to the 0.01 lot floor without breaching 1% risk. The pips number (+39,802, PF 1.79) is real but it is NOT tradeable at this balance.

m1_lower_tf_revalidation_2026_09_30.conclusion: M1 REJECTED, as the def's own warning predicted. PF 0.77, MC ruin 100%, and a $1,000 account loses 25% in 68 days. M5, M15 also rejected. M30 is MC-robust but unprofitable in dollars. The def's standing instruction 'D1 execution is MANDATORY, do not port to lower timeframes' is now backed by a full measured sweep, not just H1/H4.

august_2026_replay.warning: single month, descriptive only; contradicts the multi-year H1 result and is therefore noise

results.last_sunday_2026_09_27: 0 setups. 24 H1 bars, +0.47% move, no D1 level swept.

status_detail.state: RESEARCH — not approved for live trading
required_before_paper: month-by-month OOS replay on D1 (not just aggregate multi-year)
parameter sensitivity around min_sweep_atr 0.10-0.40 and close_pos_min 0.60-0.80
verification on a second BTC symbol (BTCEUR#) to separate BTC edge from BTCUSD quirk
status_detail.sample_size_caveat: 36 trades over 13.7 years. Low frequency, justified by D1 context, but the error bars are wide.

honesty_note: Mean-reversion-at-level is the same family as the already-rejected V3/V4/V7 on gold. No parameter was chosen to make a backtest look good. The single robust config was found by reporting every family and every sweep definition side by side rather than picking a winner.
